What to check in the PDF
  1. Cover page fills the whole first page edge to edge, with no header or footer on it.
  2. Every other page shows 'Page X of Y' at the bottom and the report title at the top right.
  3. Each chapter (green heading with underline) starts on a new page.
  4. Long tables repeat their dark green header row at the top of every page they continue on.
  5. No table row is split in half across a page break.
  6. Totals rows (bold, light green) appear once, at the end of the table (or repeated at each page bottom - note which your tool does).
  7. Negative numbers show in red. Background colors and stripes are printed, not dropped.
  8. The 8-column ledger fits the page width without being cut off on the right.
  9. Table of contents shows dotted leaders and page numbers (advanced: many tools skip this).
